    <script src="https://flyonui.becdn.net/pro/libs/flyonui/flyonui.js"></script>
    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })

    window.addEventListener("load", () => {
      // Product List Table
      const { dataTable } = new HSDataTable("#product-dashboard", {
        dom: "B", // Required for buttons to work
        buttons: [
          {
            extend: "copy",
            exportOptions: {
              columns: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] // Columns to include (adjust indices as needed)
            }
          },
          {
            extend: "csv",
            exportOptions: {
              columns: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
            }
          },
          {
            extend: "excel",
            exportOptions: {
              columns: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
            }
          },
          {
            extend: "pdf",
            exportOptions: {
              columns: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
            }
          },
          {
            extend: "print",
            exportOptions: {
              columns: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
            }
          }
        ]
      })

      // Remove extra button due to dom: 'B', ;
      const buttons = document.querySelectorAll("#dropdown-datatable-with-export .dropdown-menu button")
      document.querySelectorAll("#product-dashboard .dt-buttons").forEach(buttonContainer => {
        buttonContainer.style.display = "none"
      })

      buttons.forEach(btn => {
        const type = btn.getAttribute("data-datatable-action-type")
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => dataTable.button(`.buttons-${type}`).trigger())
      })

      // Select Stock/Status/Category
      const selectStock = document.querySelector("#select-stock")
      const selectStatus = document.querySelector("#select-status")
      const selectCategory = document.querySelector("#select-category")

      dataTable.search.fixed("all", (searchStr, data, index) => {
        const isStockSelected = selectStock.value === "all" ? "" : selectStock.value.toLowerCase()
        const isCategorySelected = selectCategory.value === "all" ? "" : selectCategory.value.toLowerCase()
        const isStatusSelected = selectStatus.value === "all" ? "" : selectStatus.value.toLowerCase()

        // Parse HTML content to text for category and status
        const parser = new DOMParser()
        const selectedCategoryText = parser.parseFromString(data[2], "text/html").body.textContent.trim().toLowerCase()
        const selectedStatusText = parser.parseFromString(data[7], "text/html").body.textContent.trim().toLowerCase()

        // Dynamically check the checkbox state from the actual DOM
        const row = dataTable.row(index).node() // Get the actual row node (DOM element)
        const stockCell = row.querySelector('td:nth-child(4) input[type="checkbox"]') // Get the checkbox inside the 4th column

        // Check if the checkbox is checked
        const isCheckboxChecked = stockCell ? stockCell.checked : false
        const selectedStockText = isCheckboxChecked ? "in stock" : "out of stock" // Determine stock status based on checkbox state

        // Return a boolean indicating whether all conditions are met
        return (
          (isStockSelected === "" || isStockSelected === selectedStockText) &&
          (isCategorySelected === "" || isCategorySelected === selectedCategoryText) &&
          (isStatusSelected === "" || isStatusSelected === selectedStatusText)
        )
      })

      if (selectStock) selectStock.addEventListener("change", () => dataTable.draw())
      if (selectStatus) selectStatus.addEventListener("change", () => dataTable.draw())
      if (selectCategory)
        selectCategory.addEventListener("change", () => dataTable.draw())

        // Charts
      ;(function () {
        // Order Area Chart with gradient
        buildChart("#order-chart", () => ({
          chart: {
            height: 104,
            type: "area",
            toolbar: {
              show: false
            },
            sparkline: {
              enabled: true
            }
          },
          markers: {
            size: 6,
            colors: "transparent",
            strokeColors: "transparent",
            strokeWidth: 4,
            discrete: [
              {
                fillColor: "var(--color-base-100)",
                seriesIndex: 0,
                dataPointIndex: 6,
                strokeColor: "var(--color-success)",
                strokeWidth: 2,
                size: 5,
                radius: 8
              }
            ],
            hover: {
              size: 7
            }
          },
          grid: {
            show: false,
            padding: {
              top: 15,
              right: 7,
              left: 0,
              bottom: 0
            }
          },
          colors: ["var(--color-success)"],
          fill: {
            type: "gradient",
            gradient: {
              shadeIntensity: 1,
              opacityFrom: 0.4,
              gradientToColors: ["var(--color-base-100)"],
              opacityTo: 0.1,
              stops: [0, 100]
            }
          },
          dataLabels: {
            enabled: false
          },
          stroke: {
            width: 2,
            curve: "smooth"
          },
          series: [
            {
              name: "Order",
              data: [180, 175, 275, 140, 205, 190, 295]
            }
          ],
          xaxis: {
            show: false,
            lines: {
              show: false
            },
            labels: {
              show: false
            },
            axisBorder: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          yaxis: {
            show: false
          }
        }))

        // Sales Radial Chart
        buildChart("#sales-chart", () => ({
          chart: {
            height: 140,
            width: 140,
            sparkline: {
              enabled: true
            },
            parentHeightOffset: 0,
            type: "radialBar"
          },
          colors: ["var(--color-accent)"],
          series: [50],
          plotOptions: {
            radialBar: {
              startAngle: -90,
              endAngle: 90,
              hollow: {
                size: "60%"
              },
              track: {
                background: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 10%, transparent)"
              },
              dataLabels: {
                name: {
                  show: false
                },
                value: {
                  fontSize: "18px",
                  fontFamily: "Inter, ui-sans-serif",
                  color: "var(--color-base-content)",
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  offsetY: -5
                }
              }
            }
          },
          stroke: {
            lineCap: "round"
          },
          grid: {
            show: false,
            padding: {
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              top: 0,
              bottom: 3
            }
          },
          labels: ["Progress"]
        }))

        // New Visitors Bar Chart
        buildChart("#new-visitors-chart", () => ({
          chart: {
            height: 120,
            width: 220,
            parentHeightOffset: 0,
            type: "bar",
            toolbar: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          plotOptions: {
            bar: {
              barHeight: "75%",
              columnWidth: "54%",
              startingShape: "rounded",
              endingShape: "rounded",
              borderRadius: 5,
              distributed: true
            }
          },
          grid: {
            show: false,
            padding: {
              top: -25,
              bottom: -12
            }
          },
          states: {
            hover: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            },
            active: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            }

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })

    window.addEventListener("load", () => {
      // Invoice DataTable
      const { dataTable } = new HSDataTable("#users-invoices")

      const filterStatus = document.querySelector("#filter-status")

      dataTable.search.fixed("all", (searchStr, data, index) => {
        const isStatusSelected = filterStatus.value === "all" ? "" : filterStatus.value.toLowerCase()
        // Parse HTML content to text
        const parser = new DOMParser()
        const htmlDoc = parser.parseFromString(data[2], "text/html")
        const selectedStatusText = htmlDoc.querySelector(".tooltip-content p").textContent.trim().toLowerCase()
        // Return a boolean indicating whether all conditions are met
        return isStatusSelected === "" || isStatusSelected === selectedStatusText
      })

      if (filterStatus) filterStatus.addEventListener("change", () => dataTable.draw())

      // Delete record

      const userTable = document.querySelector(".datatables-users")

      const tableBody = userTable?.querySelector("tbody")
      if (tableBody) {
        tableBody.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
          if (event.target.parentElement.classList.contains("delete-record")) {
            deleteRecord(event)
          }
        })
      }

      function deleteRecord(event) {
        let row = event.target.parentElement.closest("tr")

        if (row) {
          dataTable.row(row).remove().draw()

          },

            radialBar: {
              size: 150,

              startAngle: -150,

                size: "55%"
              },
              track: {
                background: "var(--color-base-100)",
                strokeWidth: "100%"
              },
              dataLabels: {
                name: {
                  offsetY: 20,
                  color: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 80%, transparent)",
                  fontSize: "14px",
                  fontWeight: "500",
                  fontFamily: "Inter, ui-sans-serif"
                },
                value: {
                  offsetY: -15,
                  color: "var(--color-base-content)",
                  fontSize: "24px",
                  fontWeight: "500",
                  fontFamily: "Inter, ui-sans-serif"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          colors: ["var(--color-primary)"],
          fill: {
            type: "gradient",
            gradient: {
              shade: "dark",

            }

          },

            }

                type: "none"
              }
            },
            active: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            }
          }
        }))

        // Earning Report Chart
        buildChart("#reportBarChart", () => ({
          chart: {
            height: 145,
            type: "bar",
            toolbar: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          plotOptions: {
            bar: {
              barHeight: "60%",
              columnWidth: "60%",
              startingShape: "rounded",
              endingShape: "rounded",
              borderRadius: 4,
              distributed: true
            }
          },

            show: false,
            padding: {
              top: -20,
              bottom: 0,
              left: -10,
              right: -10
            }

            "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary) 20%, transparent)",
            "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary) 20%, transparent)",

            "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary) 20%, transparent)"
          ],
          dataLabels: {
            enabled: false
          },
          series: [
            {
              name: "Earning",
              data: [150, 400, 300, 200, 380, 250, 320]
            }
          ],
          legend: {
            show: false
          },
          xaxis: {
            categories: ["Mo", "Tu", "We", "Th", "Fr", "Sa", "Su"],
            axisBorder: {
              show: false
            },
            axisTicks: {
              show: false
            },

                colors: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 50%, transparent)",
                fontSize: "12px",
                fontFamily: "Inter, ui-sans-serif"
              }
            }
          },
          tooltip: {
            custom: function (props) {
              // Correctly accessing categories from xaxis
              const { categories } = props.ctx.opts.xaxis
              const { dataPointIndex } = props

              // Call the buildTooltip function and pass in the relevant options
              return buildTooltip(props, {
                title: categories[dataPointIndex],
                hasTextLabel: true,
                labelDivider: ":",
                seriesExtClasses: "gap-2"
              })
            }
          },
          yaxis: {
            labels: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          states: {
            hover: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            },
            active: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            }
          }
        }))

        // Order Statistics Chart
        buildChart("#orderStatisticsChart", () => ({
          chart: {
            height: 125,
            width: 135,
            type: "donut",
            offsetX: 15
          },
          labels: ["Electronic", "Sports", "Decor", "Fashion"],
          series: [50, 85, 25, 40],

          stroke: {
            width: 5,
            colors: ["var(--color-base-100)"]
          },
          dataLabels: {
            enabled: false,
            formatter: function (val, opt) {
              return parseInt(val) + "%"
            }
          },
          legend: {
            show: false
          },
          grid: {
            padding: {
              top: 0,
              bottom: 0,
              right: 15
            }
          },
          plotOptions: {
            pie: {
              donut: {
                size: "75%",
                labels: {
                  show: true,
                  value: {
                    fontSize: "1rem",
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: "var(--color-base-content)",
                    offsetY: -17,
                    formatter: function (val) {
                      return parseInt(val) + "%"
                    }
                  },
                  name: {
                    offsetY: 17
                  },
                  total: {
                    show: true,
                    fontSize: "14px",
                    fontWeight: 500,
                    color: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 80%, transparent)",
                    label: "Weekly",
                    formatter: function (w) {
                      return "38%"
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          },
          states: {
            active: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            }
          }
        }))
      })()
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })

        // Parse HTML content to text
        const parser = new DOMParser()
        const htmlDoc = parser.parseFromString(data[2], "text/html")
        const selectedStatusText = htmlDoc.querySelector(".tooltip-content p").textContent.trim().toLowerCase()
        // Return a boolean indicating whether all conditions are met
        return isStatusSelected === "" || isStatusSelected === selectedStatusText

              const { categories } = props.ctx.opts.xaxis
              const { dataPointIndex } = props

              // Call the buildTooltip function and pass in the relevant options
              return buildTooltip(props, {
                title: categories[dataPointIndex],
                hasTextLabel: true,
                labelDivider: ":",
                seriesExtClasses: "gap-2"
              })
            }
          },
          yaxis: {
            labels: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          states: {
            hover: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            },
            active: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            }
          }
        }))

        // Order Statistics Chart
        buildChart("#orderStatisticsChart", () => ({
          chart: {
            height: 125,
            width: 135,
            type: "donut",
            offsetX: 15
          },
          labels: ["Electronic", "Sports", "Decor", "Fashion"],
          series: [50, 85, 25, 40],
          colors: ["var(--color-success)", "var(--color-primary)", "var(--color-secondary)", "var(--color-info)"],
          stroke: {
            width: 5,
            colors: ["var(--color-base-100)"]
          },
          dataLabels: {
            enabled: false,
            formatter: function (val, opt) {
              return parseInt(val) + "%"
            }
          },
          legend: {
            show: false
          },
          grid: {
            padding: {
              top: 0,
              bottom: 0,
              right: 15
            }
          },
          plotOptions: {
            pie: {
              donut: {
                size: "75%",
                labels: {
                  show: true,
                  value: {
                    fontSize: "1rem",
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: "var(--color-base-content)",
                    offsetY: -17,
                    formatter: function (val) {
                      return parseInt(val) + "%"
                    }
                  },
                  name: {
                    offsetY: 17
                  },
                  total: {
                    show: true,
                    fontSize: "14px",
                    fontWeight: 500,
                    color: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 80%, transparent)",
                    label: "Weekly",
                    formatter: function (w) {
                      return "38%"
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          },
          states: {
            active: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            }
          }
        }))
      })()
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script src="https://flyonui.becdn.net/pro/libs/flyonui/flyonui.js"></script>
    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the header
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })

    window.addEventListener("load", () => {
      ;(function () {
        buildChart("#shipmentChart", () => ({
          chart: {
            type: "bar",
            height: 300,

              show: false
            },
            zoom: {
              enabled: false
            }
          },
          series: [

              name: "Last Week",
              data: [14, 32, 5, 18, 8, 12, 35]

            {

              data: [33, 38, 10, 28, 27, 30, 40]

          colors: ["var(--color-primary)", "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary) 20%, #fff)"],
          plotOptions: {
            bar: {
              horizontal: false,
              columnWidth: "16px",
              startingShape: "rounded",
              borderRadiusApplication: "end",
              borderRadius: 6
            }
          },
          legend: {
            show: false
          },
          dataLabels: {
            enabled: false
          },
          stroke: {
            show: false
          },

            axisTicks: {
              show: false
            },
            crosshairs: {

            },
            labels: {
              style: {
                colors: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 50%, transparent)",
                fontSize: "14px",
                fontFamily: "Inter, ui-sans-serif",
                fontWeight: 400
              },
              formatter: title => title.slice(0, 3)

          },
          yaxis: {
            labels: {

              min: 0,

            }
          },
          grid: {

          },
          states: {

                type: "darken"
              }
            }
          },
          responsive: [
            {
              breakpoint: 512,
              options: {
                plotOptions: {
                  bar: {
                    columnWidth: "12px"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }))
      })()
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script src="https://flyonui.becdn.net/pro/libs/flyonui/flyonui.js"></script>
    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the header
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })

    window.addEventListener("load", () => {
      ;(function () {
        // totalCustomer
        buildChart("#totalCustomer", () => ({
          chart: {
            type: "bar",
            height: 300,
            stacked: true,

      // Datatable
      const { dataTable } = new HSDataTable("#users-invoices")

      const filterStatus = document.querySelector("#filter-status")

      dataTable.search.fixed("all", (searchStr, data, index) => {
        const isStatusSelected = filterStatus.value === "all" ? "" : filterStatus.value.toLowerCase()
        // Parse HTML content to text
        const parser = new DOMParser()
        const htmlDoc = parser.parseFromString(data[2], "text/html")
        const selectedStatusText = htmlDoc.querySelector(".tooltip-content p").textContent.trim().toLowerCase()
        // Return a boolean indicating whether all conditions are met
        return isStatusSelected === "" || isStatusSelected === selectedStatusText
      })

      if (filterStatus) filterStatus.addEventListener("change", () => dataTable.draw())

      // Delete record

      const userTable = document.querySelector(".datatables-users")

      const tableBody = userTable?.querySelector("tbody")
      if (tableBody) {
        tableBody.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
          if (event.target.parentElement.classList.contains("delete-record")) {
            deleteRecord(event)
          }
        })
      }

      function deleteRecord(event) {
        let row = event.target.parentElement.closest("tr")

        if (row) {
          dataTable.row(row).remove().draw()
        }
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the header

    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })

        // Parse HTML content to text
        const parser = new DOMParser()
        const htmlDoc = parser.parseFromString(data[2], "text/html")
        const selectedStatusText = htmlDoc.querySelector(".tooltip-content p").textContent.trim().toLowerCase()
        // Return a boolean indicating whether all conditions are met
        return isStatusSelected === "" || isStatusSelected === selectedStatusText
      })

      if (filterStatus) filterStatus.addEventListener("change", () => dataTable.draw())

      // Delete record

      const userTable = document.querySelector(".datatables-users")

      const tableBody = userTable?.querySelector("tbody")
      if (tableBody) {

          if (event.target.parentElement.classList.contains("delete-record")) {
            deleteRecord(event)
          }
        })
      }

      function deleteRecord(event) {
        let row = event.target.parentElement.closest("tr")

    <script src="https://flyonui.becdn.net/pro/libs/flyonui/flyonui.js"></script>
    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })

    // Transactions Chart

    window.addEventListener("load", () => {
      ;(function () {
        // totalExportChart Chart
        buildChart("#totalExportChart", () => ({
          chart: {
            height: 250,
            stacked: true,
            type: "bar",
            parentHeightOffset: 0,
            toolbar: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          tooltip: {
            y: {
              formatter: function (val) {
                return Math.abs(val)
              }
            }
          },
          legend: { show: false },
          dataLabels: { enabled: false },
          colors: ["var(--color-info)", "var(--color-primary)"],
          grid: {
            borderColor: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 20%, transparent)",
            strokeDashArray: 10,
            xaxis: { lines: { show: true } },
            yaxis: { lines: { show: false } },
            padding: {
              top: -5,
              bottom: -25
            }
          },
          states: {
            hover: { filter: { type: "none" } },
            active: { filter: { type: "none" } }
          },
          plotOptions: {
            bar: {
              borderRadius: 5,
              barHeight: "40%",
              horizontal: true,
              endingShape: "flat",
              startingShape: "rounded"
            }
          },
          labels: ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul"],
          xaxis: {
            position: "top",
            axisTicks: { show: false },
            axisBorder: { show: false },
            categories: ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul"],
            labels: {
              style: {
                colors: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 50%, transparent)",
                fontSize: "13px",
                fontFamily: "Inter"
              },
              formatter: function (val) {
                return Math.abs(Math.round(val))
              }
            }
          },
          yaxis: { labels: { show: false } },
          series: [
            {
              name: "Transactions",
              data: [83, 153, 213, 279, 213, 153, 83]
            },
            {
              name: "Shipped",
              data: [-84, -156, -216, -282, -216, -156, -84]
            }
          ]
        }))

        // Performance Chart
        buildChart("#customerRatingsChart", () => ({
          chart: {
            height: 212,
            toolbar: { show: false },
            zoom: { enabled: false },
            type: "line",
            dropShadow: {
              enabled: true,
              enabledOnSeries: [1],
              top: 13,
              left: 4,
              blur: 3,
              color: "#000",
              opacity: 0.09
            }
          },
          series: [
            {
              name: "Last Month",
              data: [20, 54, 20, 38, 22, 28, 16, 19, 11]
            },
            {
              name: "This Month",
              data: [20, 32, 22, 65, 40, 46, 34, 70, 75]
            }
          ],
          stroke: {
            curve: "smooth",
            dashArray: [8, 0],
            width: [3, 4]
          },
          legend: {
            show: false
          },
          colors: ["color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 20%, transparent)", "var(--color-primary)"],
          grid: {
            show: false
          },
          tooltip: {
            custom: function (props) {
              // Correctly accessing categories from xaxis
              const { categories } = props.ctx.opts.xaxis
              const { dataPointIndex } = props

              // Call the buildTooltip function and pass in the relevant options
              return buildTooltip(props, {
                title: categories[dataPointIndex],
                valuePrefix: "",
                hasTextLabel: true,
                labelDivider: ":",
                seriesExtClasses: "gap-2"
              })
            }
          },
          markers: {
            size: 6,
            colors: "transparent",
            strokeColors: "transparent",
            strokeWidth: 5,
            hover: {
              size: 6
            },
            discrete: [
              {
                fillColor: "#fff",
                seriesIndex: 1,
                dataPointIndex: 8,
                strokeColor: "var(--color-primary)",
                size: 6
              },
              {
                fillColor: "#fff",
                seriesIndex: 1,
                dataPointIndex: 3,
                strokeColor: "#000",
                size: 6
              }
            ],
            offsetX: -2
          },
          xaxis: {
            labels: {
              style: {
                colors: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 80%, transparent)",
                fontSize: "14px",
                fontFamily: "Inter, ui-sans-serif"
              }
            },
            axisTicks: {
              show: false
            },
            categories: [" ", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul"],
            axisBorder: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          yaxis: {
            show: false
          }
        }))

        // External Link Chart
        buildChart("#externalLinkChart", () => ({
          chart: {
            type: "bar",
            height: 220,
            stacked: true,
            toolbar: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          series: [
            {
              name: "Google Analytics ",
              data: [75, 30, 76, 35, 40, 86, 35]
            },
            {
              name: "Facebook Ads",
              data: [25, 89, 25, 60, 60, 25, 60]
            }
          ],
          plotOptions: {
            bar: {
              horizontal: false,
              columnWidth: "35%",
              borderRadius: 5,
              startingShape: "rounded",
              endingShape: "rounded",
              borderRadiusApplication: "around"
            }
          },
          dataLabels: {
            enabled: false
          },
          stroke: {
            curve: "smooth",
            width: 6,
            lineCap: "round",
            colors: ["transparent"]
          },
          legend: {
            show: false
          },
          colors: ["var(--color-primary)", "var(--color-base-content)"],
          fill: {
            opacity: 1
          },
          grid: {
            show: true,
            strokeDashArray: 10,
            borderColor: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 20%, transparent)"
          },
          xaxis: {
            labels: {
              show: false
            },
            axisTicks: {
              show: false
            },
            axisBorder: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          yaxis: {
            labels: {
              show: false
            }
          },
          responsive: [
            {
              breakpoint: 770,
              options: {
                plotOptions: {
                  bar: {
                    columnWidth: "20%"
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            {
              breakpoint: 610,
              options: {
                plotOptions: {
                  bar: {
                    columnWidth: "30%",
                    borderRadius: 6
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            {
              breakpoint: 484,
              options: {
                plotOptions: {
                  bar: {
                    columnWidth: "40%",
                    borderRadius: 5
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          ],
          states: {
            hover: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            },
            active: {
              filter: {
                type: "none"
              }
            }
          }
        }))
      })()

      // Datatable
      // Delete record
      const { dataTable } = new HSDataTable("#users-dashboard")

      const userTable = document.querySelector(".datatables-users")

      const tableBody = userTable?.querySelector("tbody")
      if (tableBody) {
        tableBody.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
          if (event.target.parentElement.classList.contains("delete-record")) {
            deleteRecord(event)
          }
        })
      }

      function deleteRecord(event) {
        let row = event.target.parentElement.closest("tr")

        if (row) {
          dataTable.row(row).remove().draw()
        }
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>
